we discovered a new series of indole derivatives with strong inhibitory activities for class I HDACs, and the structure activity relationship was revealed.
indole recognition cap and SAHA combined to produce a new HDAC inhibitor with improved potency.
indole derivatives containing aliphatic-chain-hydroxamates were identified to possess strong HDAC inhibitory activities and selectivity.

the discovery of novel HDAC inhibitors that could potentially be used to treat various diseases.
the development of new HDAC inhibitors and provides useful insights into the development of selective HDAC inhibitors.

indole derivatives containing hydroxamate moieties with a two-carbons linker are potent HDAC inhibitors.
the indole-containing hydroxamates were potent inhibitors of HDAC and may serve as lead compounds for the development of novel HDAC inhibitors.
the indole-containing compounds 6j, 6k and 6l are promising candidates for HDAC inhibitors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
indole recognition cap combined with SAHA can be a good template for the discovery of novel HDAC inhibitors.

the indole-based hydroxamates are promising HDAC inhibitors and could be used as lead compounds in drug development.
the indole recognition cap is a promising scaffold to develop potent HDAC inhibitors with selectivity.
